The '''spaceport''' on [[Ataria Island]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Spira/Legends|Spira]] was the only [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] authorized to receive [[Passenger liner/Legends|passenger liners]].

==Description==
[[Ataria Island]]'s [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] was a beautifully decorated installation, and was the only spaceport on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Spira/Legends|Spira]] that was authorized to receive [[Passenger liner/Legends|passenger liners]]. Unlike many of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] spaceports, it was not a drear mass of fuel-stained [[Concrete/Legends|concrete]] and [[Steel/Legends|steel]] structures. The landing pads of Ataria Island's spaceport were coated in [[Color/Legends|red]] [[Marble/Legends|marble]], which were coated and super-sealed. Each landing cradle was surrounded by planters full of exotic plant life, which were protected from the downblasts and winds generated by passenger liners by invisible [[Force field/Legends|force fields]].<ref name="TSR" />

The main passenger terminal was as luxurious as the landing fields, with comfort and class being the primary concern. Arcing white walls dominated the structure, inlaid with mosaics of underwater scenes. A tropical theme pervaded the building, with fountains and potted palms on display, and ceiling fans throughout the facility. During the Spira Regatta, banners proclaiming the event were on display.<ref name="TSR" />

A small compound off to the side of the spaceport housed the space vessels assigned to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] contingent on the planet. While less impressive looking than the spaceport itself, it did contain gleaming [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]], [[GAT-12 Skipray Blastboat|Skipray Blastboats]], and [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttles]].<ref name="TSR" />

Customs was staffed by members of the [[Spira Security Police]], and customs inspections were generally brief as long as no-one attempted to smuggle proscribed items through the checkpoint. Thousands of [[Droid/Legends|droids]] serviced the spaceport, maintaining the [[Starship/Legends|starships]] and landing cradles, and working as baggage attendants.<ref name="TSR" />

==History==
The spaceport was the only one on Spira authorized to received passenger liners. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the passenger liner ''[[Madallo]]'' landed on the planet just prior to the [[345th annual Spira Regatta Open]]. A team of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] agents booked passage aboard the ''Madallo'' to infiltrate the planet.<ref name="TSR" />
